body:
Reviewed head `719cdcd565` against base `c12df586b6`. Found one compatibility issue in the software attention fallback, detailed inline.

Validation: an isolated host probe exercised all 65,536 token masks for the 16-token packed K block store and checked that absent tokens remained unchanged. All passed. A Clang 19 compile probe called the production `apply_page_tok` function with 32 query heads, one K/V head, 128 dimensions per head, and float queries. It compiled with `TRON_K_VNNI` disabled and failed at the new head-count assertion with it enabled.

Also inspected cache copies, partial-page masks, worker synchronization, device staging ownership, build configuration, and tests. Full test suites and AMX/FPGA hardware tests were not rerun. I did not find a currently registered model with the affected query-to-K/V head ratio.
